tidies.title: Old simulators
tidies.detail: Simulator runtimes not used in 60 days, and the simulators left without one. Xcode downloads a runtime again when you need it.

tidies.title: Old build folders
tidies.detail: A project's build output (Rust's target, Flutter's and Gradle's build, Swift's .build, .next, dist) that nothing has built into or run from for 14 days. Its next build makes it again, from scratch.

tidies.title: Old node_modules
tidies.detail: A project's node_modules that nothing has installed into or run from for 14 days. npm, yarn, pnpm or bun puts it back from the lockfile, downloading what isn't in its cache.

tidies.title: Old Rust build caches
tidies.detail: A Rust build's incremental caches no build has used for 30 days: the next build of that project's own crates is slower, nothing else.

last.note: Deleted the old incremental caches of 2 Rust projects

tidies.title: Caches apps stopped using
tidies.detail: App and tool caches nothing has written to for 30 days, emptied while their app is closed; the app makes what it needs again.

tidies.title: Build folders out of Time Machine
tidies.detail: Keeps the folders a build or an install makes again (target, build, node_modules, .venv, Pods) out of Time Machine's backups, new ones too: less to send over the network and less room on the backup disk. Nothing is deleted.

last.note: Kept 4 folders out of Time Machine
